keyEvents.text: David Larrubia (Malaga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Rafita (Malaga) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Real Betis 1, Malaga 0. Marc Bartra (Real Betis) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Isco with a cross following a set piece situation.
Goal! Real Betis 2, Malaga 0. Pablo Fornals (Real Betis) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner following a set piece situation.
Second Half begins Real Betis 2, Malaga 0.
Substitution, Malaga. Chupe replaces David Larrubia.
Substitution, Malaga. Rafa Rodríguez replaces Ramón Enríquez.
Substitution, Real Betis. Antony replaces Rodrigo Riquelme.
Substitution, Real Betis. Dani Ceballos replaces Isco.
Delay in match because of an injury Carlos Puga (Malaga).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Real Betis 2, Malaga 1. Adrián Niño (Malaga) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Real Betis. Aitor Ruibal replaces Troy Parrott.
Substitution, Malaga. Juani replaces Fernando Calero.
Substitution, Malaga. Jens Cajuste replaces Carlos Dotor.
Substitution, Real Betis. Ángel Ortiz replaces Héctor Bellerín.
Substitution, Real Betis. Nelson Deossa replaces Pablo Fornals.
Substitution, Malaga. Eneko Jauregi replaces Adrián Niño.
Nelson Deossa (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Aitor Ruibal (Real Betis) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Real Betis 2, Malaga 1.
